scope: Retrospective agreement with previously exposed archived minute rows at unchanged historical coordinates; not an independent holdout, physical accuracy measurement, or official-equivalence claim

modelDefinitions.localSPA: Current diyanet-published-spa-point-v1, continuous SPA and declared ordinary northern guard

interpretationDefinitions.printed-date-actual-IANA: Source clock on printed row date with actual IANA offset
interpretationDefinitions.conditional-evening-cycle-actual-IANA: Conditional: only Isha advances a civil day where its source clock precedes source Maghrib; publisher event-date meaning is not proven

comparisonMeaning.pairedAvailable: Source usable and both models select an instant; full coverage remains separately reported
comparisonMeaning.bothCalculated: Paired subset where both statuses are calculated, excluding explicit estimates; event conventions still differ
comparisonMeaning.signedError: Model minus source in elapsed UTC minutes; no modulo-day repair
comparisonMeaning.season: Meteorological seasons by hemisphere outside the tropics; absolute latitude <23.44 uses labeled calendar quarters

metadata.phaseFrame: elapsed UTC minutes from the event-owning upper-meridian transit
metadata.ratioDefinition: (last-real-Fajr minus preceding selected Maghrib) / (3 × that actual selected-horizon night)
metadata.nightlyHorizonBasis: UTC interval from Maghrib on solar-cycle date D to Sunrise on solar-cycle date D+1; no fixed 1440-minute day assumption
metadata.fajrEstimateBound: selected next-cycle Sunrise minus one-third night; any positive 2-degree addition makes the actual determined Fajr no later than this upper bound
metadata.horizonGate: all padded-row raw and selected daylight and every consecutive padded raw and selected night are strictly greater than 300 minutes
metadata.transitionEnvelopeBasis: minimum/maximum across every consecutive padded night, including previous-December-31 Isha and following-January-1 Fajr candidates

independentCheck.method: Python standard library only; independently parsed frozen forecast/reference JSON; no JS scorer imports
independentCheck.sourceInterpretationMethod: Python zoneinfo checks primary UTC instants render to their declared printed local dates; secondary Isha is advanced one date only when printed local Isha clock is earlier than the same-date Maghrib clock; zero/null cells remain excluded
independentCheck.pairedSubsetCaveat: bothCalculated excludes explicit model estimates only; it does not make the two models' sampling epochs, event ownership, seasonal policies, or conventions equivalent

outlierArithmeticCheck.scope: Independent arithmetic confirmation of the largest conditional Isha residual, selected after the retrospective comparison. Not a new calendar holdout or observed-onset validation.

publication.content: Aggregate results and declared historical case coordinates only; no original source rows, per-day forecasts, or personal GPS inputs.
publication.reproducibility: The diagnostic CLI independently recomputes any supplied point. Reproducing these publisher-agreement aggregates requires the retained private reference corpus; public tests validate pins and accounting, not original source clocks.
